hook: Weil, deshalb, um … zu, das liegt daran, dass: mix these frames and your reasons sound fluent instead of mechanical.
intro: Twelve sentences from one short account — why someone moved from Munich to Leipzig — that give reasons and purposes, to listen to and repeat. The frames: …, weil … · …, deshalb … · …, um … zu … · Der Grund ist, dass … · …, denn … · Das liegt daran, dass … (that is because) · Aus diesem Grund … · …, damit … · Deswegen … · Das hat zwei Gründe: … An opinion without a reason convinces nobody — in a meeting, a discussion with friends or an e-mail — so these frames must be automatic. Say them with the verb in the right place: weil, dass and damit send it to the end; deshalb, deswegen and aus diesem Grund keep it second; denn changes nothing; um … zu ends in zu + infinitive. Vary the frame: three weil-clauses in a row sound mechanical, a mix sounds fluent.
tips[0].title: Ways to say why
tips[0].text: …, weil … (verb last) · …, denn … (normal order) · Deshalb / Deswegen / Aus diesem Grund … (verb second) · Der Grund ist, dass … · Das liegt daran, dass … (verb last).
tips[0].check.why: deshalb takes position 1 of its clause, so the verb comes straight after it: deshalb ging ich.
tips[0].visual.caption: Rotate the frames so your reasons don't all start with weil.
tips[0].visual.moves[0].label: Reason
tips[0].visual.moves[1].label: Result
tips[0].visual.moves[2].label: Purpose
tips[1].title: Reason vs purpose
tips[1].text: weil / denn look back at the cause; um … zu and damit look forward to the goal. um … zu when the subject stays the same, damit when it changes.
tips[1].check.why: The clause names a goal with zu + infinitive and the same subject, so um … zu.
tips[2].title: Rotate the frames
tips[2].text: weil → deshalb → um … zu → das liegt daran, dass. One answer, four frames, no repetition.
tips[2].check.why: Aus diesem Grund fills position 1 and the verb follows it; weil sends the verb to the end and denn keeps normal order, so neither fits here.
remember[0]: weil / dass: verb last. deshalb / aus diesem Grund: verb second.
exam: Backing up an opinion with reasons is expected in the speaking and writing of the B1 exam.
